labeler: OpenAI Codex agent, single unblinded exploratory labeler
label_method: Native CSP replay trajectories plotted around canonical segment_corners deceleration entries; blue ego/red scalar opponents and observed future paths. Candidate evaluator was not imported by the labeling aid. Borderline A017/A021/A022 excluded before predictions. Chronological occupied examples; clear examples across the Nordschleife and Nurburgring recordings; five observed adjacent-loop controls. Labels are not independent human ground truth.
limitations: Correlated approaches from repeated laps; not a broad driving distribution.
All five natural adversarial controls are adjacent-track cases; pit/disconnected/wrap edge cases require separate perturbation or synthetic tests.
CSP producer sampling age does not establish transport residence time.
